I presume a sync means that the main thread gets to a certain point, which it never will because it's waiting on the GD script. This causes the deadlock.

The problem seems to be that in order for `GLTFPhysicsShape::to_resource` to make a convex hull it needs to access the mesh data which needs to make a call to the main thread:

```
FUNC2RC(SurfaceData, mesh_get_surface, RID, int)
```

If you rewrite your script so that it doesn't spawn and wait for the thread but lets the main thread continue while the model is loading, then the issue will probably be fixed.
